jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production sprite sheet for original wuxia pixel RPG. Reuse the EXACT jade cobra pillar in row2 of input reference: coiled dark jade snake stone base, purple bindings and hanging small charms, luminous poison lime eyes and open mouth. This is an 8-facing replacement head-turn sheet. DO NOT rotate the entire image or tip the column. All 8 cels MUST have the EXACT same ground base, base orientation, camera, pillar height, body coils, centered footprint. ONLY cobra neck and head yaw in eight different compass headings. Same elevated orthographic three-quarter RPG camera. Exact regular grid 4 columns by 2 rows with wide fully transparent gutters. ROW1 columns: head faces RIGHT/east, DOWN-RIGHT/southeast diagonal, DOWN/south toward viewer, DOWN-LEFT/southwest diagonal. ROW2 columns: head faces LEFT/west, UP-LEFT/northwest diagonal, UP/north away viewer showing back of head, UP-RIGHT/northeast diagonal. Anatomically readable snake head yaw and jaw orientation, diagonal angles halfway between cardinals, not just four duplicated heads. Keep extended cobra hood above same coils and same identical fixed base in all eight. Short lime venom muzzle hint may point in each direction but no long beam. Full pillar present in every cell, no clipped features. Detailed crisp pixel-art clusters, dark readable outline, pale lime poison highlights, restrained purple. Genuine transparent background; no backdrop, glow haze, labels, grid, borders, text or human. Keep all8 pillars same height and width budget, enough padding to crop independently. Reference is style and exact identity target.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original poison staff 180 DEGREE FRONTAL FAN attack VFX sheet for a top-down wuxia pixel RPG. Match lime jade venom with restrained purple from reference. Exact 4 columns x 2 rows, each cell completely independent with wide transparent gutters. Genuine transparent PNG, no backdrop, no text/grid. IMPORTANT GEOMETRY: every cel is exactly the RIGHT HALF OF A CIRCLE, a 180 degree semicircle. Circle center is the MIDDLE of its STRAIGHT VERTICAL LEFT DIAMETER; no artwork extends left of this vertical diameter. Semicircle runs from top at north through far RIGHT edge east to bottom south; the rounded outer edge spans the entire front half of the caster, no small cone, no thin full circular ring, no backward effect. ROW1 four warning pulses: the SAME exact 180 degree right-half disk footprint in all4, hollow/readable translucent pale gold and ivory stipple floor fill, thin ornate gold outer semicircular rim and straight vertical left diameter from top to bottom, restrained violet corner marks. No poison damage in warning. ROW2 four attack cels with SAME maximum footprint: green poison staff sweep from top edge, curved trail spreads over right semicircle, peak green scything trail across full180degree outer arc with readable interior and dark pixel outline, then fading poison wisps. All frames must keep the flat left border at same x and equal height. Bright lime cores, jade dark pixel clusters, crisp no blur, not UI pie chart. Flat TOP DOWN ground geometry intentional so circle diameter read exactly, no camera deformation of the footprint. NO character or weapon in either row. Art style match poison reference; production raster cels not presentation collage.
